description: This file implements a Python class 'AnthropicCacheControlHook' that manages cache control directives injection into chat message streams, specifically targeting Anthropic API message formats. It handles inserting cache control instructions into messages at specified injection points, either by message index or user role, and provides auxiliary methods and properties related to this functionality.
